verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's API can programmatically manage 'environments' [honeycomb-docs-11, honeycomb-docs-27], which implies telemetry can be kept in separate non-production spaces. A free interactive demo with sample data is also offered [honeycomb-docs-54]. However, nothing documents a dedicated sandbox for testing integrations or agents, and the MCP docs describe agents working against live Honeycomb data [honeycomb-docs-9]. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-environment documentation, guidance on isolating agent/MCP access from production environments, environment-scoped API keys for safe testing, hands-on corroboration.
